# GoodWord

> GoodWord lets a job seeker collect verified references from people they have worked with and share them as one report, as a link and as a PDF, with every job application. It is built for job seekers in India.

## Facts

- A candidate invites up to 5 people they have worked with: managers, peers, people who reported to them and clients.
- Each referee answers a short questionnaire in their own words. It takes about 5 minutes. The invite link works for 30 days.
- A report unlocks when 3 referees have responded and can include up to 5. It is valid for 12 months.
- A report contains words only. No ratings and no scores.
- The candidate cannot edit what referees wrote.
- Recruiters see each referee by role, not by name, unless that referee chose to be named. The candidate knows who wrote what.
- To open a shared report, a recruiter confirms a work email with a one-time code.
- GoodWord is not a background check. It does not verify identity documents or employment records.
